papers.title_in_file: Encoding and measurement - Quantum Computing Inc
papers.what_it_is: A QCi resource-library web page listing about one hundred abstracts, patents, conference papers and theses on photonic encoding, mode-selective quantum frequency conversion and measurement, mostly by Yu-Ping Huang and collaborators.
